+- [ ] No file imports `AgentViewKitACP`.
+- [ ] `swift test`, `Scripts/check-readme.sh` and `Scripts/test-examples.sh AgentViewKitDemo` pass.

+- [ ] `Tests/PackageStructureTests/ImportBoundaryTests.swift`: the new rule is that no target imports `FoundationModels`, `FoundationModelsRouter` or `FoundationModelsExtras`. Remove the old rule that `AgentViewKit` imports no source runtime.
